services.name: Headboat Bay Fishing
services.desc: Free tackle and frozen bait! Ages 13 and Up: $35 Ages 12 and Under: $25 Rod Rental: $5 Unlimited Live Minnows: $5 (based on availability) 2 hours and 30 minutes About Enjoy a day of bay fishing in Ocean City, Maryland. The Calico Jack is a 40' Coast Guard inspected Chesapeake Custom Headboat; offering public 2.5 hour bay fishing trips from 9:00-11:30am, 12 noon- 2:30 pm, and 3:00-5:30 pm. No fishing license is required and we generally bottom fish for flounder. Depending on the season, there is also a chance you may catch seabass, croaker, trout, or rockfish! The Captain is Fun for all ages · Free tackle & frozen bait!

services.name: Public Evening Cruise
services.desc: Ages 13 and Up: $35 Ages 12 and Under: $25 2 hours About Enjoy a day of bay fishing in Ocean City, Maryland. The Calico Jack is a 40' Coast Guard inspected Chesapeake Custom Headboat; offering public 2 hour pony/ nature cruises from 3:00-5:30 pm. The boat is designed to offer you the most comfortable experience with bench seating, restroom, and radio. The Calico Jack departs from 32nd street bayside, next to Jolly Roger Amusement Park and there is plenty of FREE parking along 32nd street. The Calico Jack Heaboat is fun for all ages!
